name: Breeches, Brazen Plunderer
description: A blue-furred goblin pirate and explosives expert of the Brazen Coalition on Ixalan, best friend of Malcolm Lee.

description_citations.text: "Breeches". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ripley Vance sends Malcolm and Breeches to investigate disappearances in Downtown, which they find deserted.
timeline.quote: Upon arrival, they found the town deserted.

citation.text: "Breeches", section "Lost Caverns of Ixalan". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In the mines, the party is attacked by mycoid-animated corpses and meets the Mycotyrant.
timeline.quote: before coming face to face with the entity that controlled them, the Mycotyrant

citation.text: "Breeches", section "Lost Caverns of Ixalan". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Breeches destroys the Mycotyrant with a powerful firearm, collapsing the mycoids.
timeline.quote: Breeches destroyed the Mycotyrant with a powerful firearm

citation.text: "Breeches", section "Lost Caverns of Ixalan". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Vraska, thought dead, contacts Breeches and Malcolm; they are overjoyed and agree to help her and Jace with a vault plot.
timeline.quote: They were overjoyed to see her alive.

citation.text: "Breeches", section "Lost Caverns of Ixalan". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Breeches joins the outlaw band as explosives expert and to secretly support Vraska.
timeline.quote: Breeches joined the team as an explosives expert

citation.text: "Breeches", section "Thunder Junction". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The gang plans to kidnap Nolan by blowing a bridge; Gisa deviates and the train nearly goes over before Kellan slows it.
timeline.quote: Kellan was able to slow the train enough for its passengers to escape before it was destroyed.

citation.text: "Breeches", section "Thunder Junction". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Oko opens the vault for Jace and Vraska; Jace takes Loot and triggers a collapse, but the team escapes, after which Breeches and Malcolm leave the plane.
timeline.quote: Breeches and Malcolm left the plane.

citation.text: "Breeches", section "Thunder Junction". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
